description: Create a PROPOSED action (task, draft, document request, channel alert) for advisor approval in the Heed dashboard. Nothing is sent, changed or posted by this tool: it only queues the request. Advisor accounts.

client_id.description: Target client, when the action concerns one client.

detail.description: Body: task description, draft text, or alert text.

source_id.description: Originating record id (e.g. a change id), for idempotency.

title.description: Short human-readable summary of the proposal.

name: propose_action
title: Propose a controlled action
